bio: Born and raised in Portland, Oregon, Andrew Reynolds currently serves as associate pastor at Bethel Baptist Church of St. Johns. Utilizing an expository preaching style, Andrew seeks to rightly divide the word of God and save the lost. Andrew is a young pastor, husband and father of two beautiful daughters. He has been preaching and teaching since 2009. Attending Multnomah University, Andrew completed his B.A. in Biblical and Theological Studies, and New Testament Greek in 2015. He then continued on to complete his Master of Divinity in 2018. He has been greatly influenced by the ministries of John MacArthur, Steve Lawson and Jack Hughes. Andrew is particularly interested in studying the history and geography of the Biblical land.
